purpose: Carry runtime faults and verifier outcomes back toward the exact Resolution revision and approved runtime subject without converting them into ResolutionDiagnostic or changing ResolutionWorkflow state.

authorities.semantic_subject: RuntimeSubjectProjection from the approved+authorized forward bridge
authorities.agent_fault: runtime preflight observation only; not semantic diagnosis and not numerical proof
authorities.graph_verifier: source-authority label transported from a structured graph verifier receipt; the inbox itself does not authenticate the receipt
authorities.vector_verifier: source-authority label transported from a structured vector comparator receipt; the inbox itself does not authenticate the receipt
authorities.interpretation: caller/agent Resolution review step remains authoritative for deciding whether evidence implies revision, a new diagnostic, rejection, or no action
authorities.math_program_verifier: source-authority label transported from a structured MathProgram verifier receipt; original runtime receipt remains authoritative and inbox transport remains observation_only
authorities.direct_math_verifier: source-authority label transported from a structured DirectMath.verifyAgainstMathProgramV9 receipt; candidate authority remains burn_direct_math, reference authority remains burn_math_program, and inbox transport remains observation_only

native_types.RuntimeEvidence: typed AgentFault, graph-verifier, MathProgram-verifier, DirectMath-verifier, or vector-verifier observation
native_types.ResolutionEvidenceInbox: bounded evidence collection tied to one compile-eligible ResolutionSnapshot and one exact RuntimeSubjectProjection

inbox_policy.requires: ResolutionSnapshot.compile_eligible == true and snapshot intent/revision exactly match RuntimeSubjectProjection
inbox_policy.mutation: inbox only; ResolutionWorkflow is not mutated
inbox_policy.canonical_constructor: ResolutionEvidenceInbox::from_authorized(resolution, approved_spec, current_policy, authorization) re-runs RuntimeSubjectProjection::from_authorized before creating the inbox
inbox_policy.lower_level_constructor: ResolutionEvidenceInbox::new(resolution, projection) is an escape hatch for hosts that already validated the projection
inbox_policy.authorization_freshness: canonical construction fails closed when the authorization snapshot is stale for the current policy

interpretation_policy.required_step: explicit Resolution review/interpretation outside this bridge

transport_boundary.note: Hosts should prefer the structured adapters over manual field extraction. The adapters parse the exact AgentFault/verifier-receipt JSON schemas and never parse legacy free-form error strings.
transport_boundary.authority_preservation: The typed payload variant fixes the source-authority class and prevents string-based class escalation, but the native inbox does not independently authenticate that host-supplied receipt fields came from WASM.
transport_boundary.unbound_runtime: representable but cannot be rejoined into a subject-bound ResolutionEvidenceInbox
transport_boundary.runtime_authority: The original verifier receipt in the runtime/proof boundary remains the authoritative verification artifact.

invariants: failed verifier evidence is an observation, not an automatic ResolutionDiagnostic
stale or foreign runtime evidence cannot enter an inbox for another Resolution revision or subject
vector comparator evidence remains explicitly caller-reference authority
the inbox is bounded and duplicate insertion is idempotent
graph verifier observation retains transported exact programIdentity provenance without claiming to authenticate the receipt
all reverse-bridge entries are observation_only; source_authority does not become native inbox proof authority
canonical inbox construction revalidates approval/subject/current authorization policy through RuntimeSubjectProjection::from_authorized
lower-level projection construction does not claim to reauthenticate a caller-supplied RuntimeSubjectProjection
structured adapters validate the source schema and authority tuple before selecting a RuntimeEvidence payload class
verifier adapter detail is derived from the structured result object rather than synthesized free-form host text
source-only receipt fields remain authoritative in the original runtime receipt and are intentionally not promoted into Resolution authority
MathProgram verifier observation preserves verifier=MathProgram.verifyFlat and reference_authority=burn_math_program without upgrading inbox transport into proof authority
MathProgram receipt program_identity.schema must be burn-research.math-program-identity.v1; graph program identities cannot cross the adapter class boundary
graph/vector/MathProgram/DirectMath adapters are authority-class-specific and fail closed on cross-class receipt tuples

DirectMath verifier observation preserves verifier=DirectMath.verifyAgainstMathProgramV9, candidate_authority=burn_direct_math, reference_authority=burn_math_program, and reference_program_generation=v9 without upgrading inbox transport into proof authority

proves: canonical inbox creation revalidates the real approved+authorized forward bridge
actual forward RuntimeSubjectProjection matches the compile-eligible ResolutionSnapshot
structured AgentFault can rejoin as observation without becoming ResolutionDiagnostic
graph verifier source-authority/outcome is preserved while transport remains observation_only and unverified
Resolution state remains unchanged after evidence recording
stale revision, foreign subject, and unbound evidence are rejected
inbox capacity is bounded at 64 entries
structured AgentFault and verifier receipt JSON are adapted without manual host field mapping
structured MathProgram verifier receipt can rejoin the exact subject as observation-only evidence without changing Resolution state
structured DirectMath verifier receipt can rejoin the exact subject as observation-only evidence while preserving candidate/reference authority and without changing Resolution state
runtimeResolutionEvidenceCapabilities is discoverable from the packaged WASM surface
reverse bridge state is not owned by WASM

audit_artifacts.acceptance: run downloaded exact-head native probe, pipe actual packaged-WASM MathProgram and DirectMath verifier receipts into the downloaded native adapter probe, and inspect packaged WASM capability surface outside CI

native_adapter_probe.input: one actual MathProgram.verifyFlat or DirectMath.verifyAgainstMathProgramV9 verifier receipt JSON object on stdin
proves: actual cross-artifact MathProgram receipt can be parsed by RuntimeEvidence::from_math_program_verifier_receipt_json
actual cross-artifact DirectMath receipt can be parsed by RuntimeEvidence::from_direct_math_verifier_receipt_json
kind/source_authority/evidence_authority/transport_integrity/outcome are derived by the strict typed adapter selected from receipt.verifier
runtime subject tuple is read from the actual receipt rather than manually reconstructed
receipt is classified exact and recorded into a subject-matched ResolutionEvidenceInbox
recording actual transported evidence does not create a diagnostic, state transition, revision, or action selection

agent_fault.subject_source: existing RuntimeSubjectProjection because AgentFault envelope has no runtime_subject field

structured_adapters.class_escalation: fail closed when source authority/verifier/candidate-authority/reference-authority/program-generation fields do not match the selected adapter

math_program_verifier_receipt.authority: wasm_verifier source label / burn_math_program reference / observation_only transport

direct_math_verifier_receipt.authority: wasm_verifier source label / burn_direct_math candidate / burn_math_program reference / observation_only transport
